description.en: From ultra-slim pod devices to powerful box mods — NEXVAP devices are engineered for premium performance.
description.zh: 从超薄 Pod 主机到强劲盒子 Mod，NEXVAP 设备精工打造，追求卓越性能。

description.en: FLUXPOD™ magnetic pods and pre-filled cartridges across 10+ flavors. Salt nic and freebase options.
description.zh: FLUXPOD™ 磁吸烟弹和预填充烟弹，10余种口味，支持盐基和游离尼古丁。

description.en: Complete device and pod bundles — everything your wholesale customers need, ready to sell.
description.zh: 设备加烟弹的完整套装，满足批发客户需求，开箱即可销售。

description.en: Sub-ohm tanks, replacement coils, and charging accessories to complete the NEXVAP ecosystem.
description.zh: Sub-Ohm 雾化仓、可换雾化芯和充电配件，完整的 NEXVAP 生态系统。

description.en: Effortless disposable and pod systems. Built for accessibility and vibrant style.
description.zh: 轻松易用的一次性设备和 Pod 系统，追求便利与鲜明风格。

description.en: NEXCORE™ powered flagship pod mod. Precision, performance, zero-leak.
description.zh: NEXCORE™ 驱动的旗舰 Pod Mod，精准、高性能、零泄漏。

description.en: Open-system refillable platform. Total control, any e-liquid.
description.zh: 开放式可填充平台，完全掌控，兼容任意烟液。

description.en: High-power box mod platform. 100W–200W for serious cloud chasers.
description.zh: 大功率盒子 Mod 平台，100W–200W，为追云族而生。
